text.en:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

Kills grant 20% increased damage, 20 Stability, and 20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size for 5 seconds.

Buff applies to Auto Rifle mode only.

Landing 15 hits within 3 seconds of each, or scoring a kill, grants 20% increased damage, 20 Stability, and 20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size for 5 seconds.

Buff applies to Auto Rifle mode only.
